extraction_notes: Catalog seed MPN SI2302-2.3A-JSM is retained. The PDF prints SI2302-2.3A, identifies JSMSEMI, states N Channel, shows a SOT-23 package, and gives compatible 20 V VDS and 2.3 A continuous drain-current ratings. The -JSM ordering suffix is not printed verbatim; identity is established from the compatible base family, manufacturer, package, ratings, and JSMSEMI header/logo and package-photo evidence.
Curve points are direct compact digitizations from the p. 2 raster plots; no points were interpolated between plotted readings.
The transfer figure does not state VDS; this condition is preserved as not stated rather than inferred.
The datasheet has no capacitance-versus-VDS plot. Ciss, Coss, and Crss are transcribed from the p. 1 table at the stated bias and frequency.
The RDS(on) table publishes both typical and maximum values for both gate-drive conditions; duplicate schema entries preserve both source semantics and inclusive maxima.
omission_reason: No capacitance-versus-VDS curve is present in the supplied PDF, so no capacitance curve was extracted.
